messages.subject: Free Statistics Learning & Teaching Resources
parts:
APOLOGIES FOR CROSS-POSTING



List members may be interested in the free Statistics teaching and learning
resources on our website at:



http://www.conceptstew.co.uk/PAGES/freeresources2.html.



As well as a plain-english glossary of statistical terms, we have a series
of discussion pieces about different aspects of statistical thinking which
people often find confusing. Where possible we use real-life examples to
illustrate these.



Concepts covered so far include decision-making and the nature of risk,
conditional probability, when to use the mean or the median, clinical
trials, the prosecutor's fallacy, sample size, etc. The next item scheduled
will be on reporting confidence intervals. We add new pieces regularly and
would be like to hear from anyone with suggestions of what we should cover.



You are welcome to use these in your own teaching or learning, and please
feel free to forward this email to anyone who might be interested.



Kind regards,



Jill
